versions.content: The value of the EcucContainerDef . multiplicity- ConfigClass attribute in the VSMD in case it is not defined in the StMD If the multiplicityConfigClass attribute of an EcucContainerDef is not defined in the StMD, it shall be defined in the VSMD for all EcucContainerDef s that have upperMultiplicity greater than lowerMultiplicity . This in- cludes vendor specific EcucContainerDef s.
